subject: Renewal + EU expansion — invoicing routing, PO handoff, and payment terms
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmesecure.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>; Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@acmesecure.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Capacity renewal + EU expansion: invoicing & PO path

Hi Irene / Jordan,

Thanks for the renewal proposal — we're ready to move forward with the renewal + the additional 150k token capacity for our EU product line. Finance asked us to confirm the invoicing path so they can issue a PO. Two quick items:

- We'll be issuing a PO (internal reference: ACME-PO-8354). Can you confirm the correct payee name and remit address for Redwood Inference?
- Our finance team needs to know if Redwood can accept a net45 term for this committed capacity (we are standardizing on net45 for EU entities).

I've attached a draft PO for your intake and copied Hannah in finance to handle the signed version. If you need a VAT ID or any tax paperwork, let me know and I'll have it pulled.

Attachments: PO_8354_draft.pdf (attachment stub)

Next step from our side: once you confirm remit/payer details and term, I'll route the signed PO to Finance and they will submit payment per the schedule.

Thanks —
Liam
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Secure
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmesecure.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:20:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Capacity renewal + EU expansion: invoicing & PO path

Hi Liam — thanks for the PO and the context. We're excited to support Acme's EU rollout. Quick confirmations so we can get Finance moving:

- Payee name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address (for PO reference / AP): 420 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
- Invoice recipient (where AP should receive PDFs/EDIs): billing-europe@redwood.ai (this routes to our EU billing queue)
- Standard payment term for this renewal: net30, but we can support net45 with a small service-level commitment adjustment. I want to loop Soojin to confirm the exact impact and any required credit approvals.

Soojin — can you confirm whether Finance can accept ACME-PO-8354 on net45 and whether we need a signed amendment to the SOW for the term change? Also confirm what tax paperwork we need from Acme (VAT ID, tax residency docs, etc.).

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>; Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@acmesecure.com>; Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmesecure.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 08:43:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Capacity renewal + EU expansion: invoicing & PO path

Hi all — looping in a few operational details from billing: 

1) Net terms: Our default for hosted renewals is net30. We can approve net45 for committed capacity deals > $50k ARR after a quick credit check and a signed PO. For net45 on ACME-PO-8354 we'll need a dated, signed PO and a short e‑mail from procurement confirming the payor (same entity as on PO).

2) Tax docs: For EU customers please provide the company VAT number (formatted as VAT: BE0123456789 or DE123456789). If Acme is a non‑EU entity paying from an EU subsidiary we may need proof of billing entity and VAT registration. A simple text file with the VAT ID and legal entity name works.

3) Invoicing routing: Please send the signed PO (PDF) to billing-europe@redwood.ai and cc finance@redwood.ai. We'll ingest the PO into our accounting system and attach it to the first invoice.

4) Invoice cadence: We can do monthly invoices against consumption or an upfront invoice for the committed capacity (preferred by some of our EU customers). If Acme prefers monthly, we'll include the PO reference on each invoice. If they prefer prepaid, we can generate a single invoice for the committed amount. See attached sample schedule.

Attachments: InvoiceSchedule_Acme_2027.xlsx (attachment stub)

If everything looks good from Acme, we'll draft a one‑line amendment to the SOW that records net45 in lieu of net30 and then route to legal for signoff.

— Soojin
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Marks <hannah.marks@acmesecure.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>; Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmesecure.com>; Finance Ops <finance@acmesecure.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Capacity renewal + EU expansion: invoicing & PO path

Hi Soojin / Irene — thanks for the clear breakdown. Attached is the signed PO (ACME-PO-8354_signed.pdf) and our VAT ID (Acme VAT: IE9876543). We've confirmed that the paying legal entity is Acme Secure Ireland Limited.

We prefer monthly invoicing against committed capacity (with PO ref on each invoice). We can accept net45. Please confirm you will:

- Accept PO ACME-PO-8354 as the billing reference on all invoices;
- Route all invoices to billing-europe@redwood.ai (our AP team will pull from there);
- Provide a single copy of the signed amendment to the SOW if required for the net45 term so our procurement file is complete.

Attachments: ACME-PO-8354_signed.pdf (attachment stub), Acme_VAT_ID.txt (attachment stub)

On a separate note — if you have an auto-collection setup for EU customers (SEPA/ACH options), please flag any required bank details or mandate forms.

Best,
Hannah Marks
Procurement Manager — Acme Secure
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Marks <hannah.marks@acmesecure.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>; Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmesecure.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Capacity renewal + EU expansion: invoicing & PO path

Thanks Hannah — all good on our side. Summary / next steps: 

- Redwood confirms payee and remit address as previously provided.
- We will accept PO ACME-PO-8354 as the invoice reference on every monthly invoice.
- Billing will issue monthly invoices to billing-europe@redwood.ai; net45 will be honored for this commitment after accounting's credit check (completed).
- Soojin will route a one-line SOW amendment (net45) to legal and send a final PDF to you for procurement record.
- We will not require any additional tax forms beyond the VAT ID you provided.

Soojin — please attach the signed amendment and the first invoice (month of July) once the PO has been ingested. Hannah / Liam — expect the first invoice in the first week of July with PO reference.

Thanks everyone — glad to get this across the finish line.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
